name: dsh-composer-history-recall
description: Recall the current session's previously-sent user messages into the composer with the arrow keys (terminal-style history), gated to the first/last line so multi-line caret movement and the slash/mention menus are never hijacked. Client-only plugin: it reuses the core conversation.input.overlay slot and inputActions.setDraft, and ships no host endpoint, no model tool and no new attack surface.
